get.description: This API endpoint provides a daily output for observed activity for a provided IP.  The field parameter defines which set of information is return, such as the daily classification changes for the IP.

parameters.name: days

schema.title: Days

parameters.description: Field over which to show activity breakdown

schema.title: Field

parameters.description: Granularity of activity date ranges. This can be in hours (e.g. Xh) or days (Xd). Valid hours are between 1 and 24. Valid days are between 1 and 90.
